visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures the entrance of a Loft retail store with a large yellow mesh backdrop and the brand logo prominently displayed. A female customer with a ponytail, wearing a white top, is viewed from behind as she browses various cosmetic products on multi-tiered metal shelves. (2) Close-up shot of a promotional sign featuring a pink cocktail graphic and the text SHINY DAYS. A person's hand reaches into the frame to display a packaged hat strap accessory, followed by a cooling gel pack for hats, highlighting specific product details under bright, uniform indoor lighting. (3) The scene shifts to rows of boxed UV-cut bucket hats labeled 99% COOL. A hand picks up a black hat box to show the illustrated instructions on the back, then focuses on a different product—a wide-brimmed sun hat with a protective cape covering a model's face and shoulders. (4) The final sequence displays various face masks and neck gaiters designed for sun protection on store shelves. The camera zooms in on two white balloons printed with COSME FESTIVAL 2025 spring summer and the Loft logo, situated above busy retail cosmetic displays.
